hooks.name: Block Unauthorized Git Commits and Pushes
hooks.description: Prevents Kiro from executing git commit or git push commands without explicit user authorization

action.command: powershell -Command "$input = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $cmd = $input.params.command; if ($cmd -match 'git\s+(commit|push)') { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('BLOQUEADO: No puedes hacer commit o push sin autorización explícita del usuario'); exit 2 } else { exit 0 }"
